title: Part 10
content_zh: It is only the perfectly sincere who can fully develop his nature. Able to fully develop his nature, he can fully develop the nature of others. Able to fully develop the nature of others, he can fully develop the nature of all things.
content_en: It is only the perfectly sincere who can fully develop his nature. Able to fully develop his nature, he can fully develop the nature of others. Able to fully develop the nature of others, he can fully develop the nature of all things.
